raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be a cook at"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the Community Center on Ulmilor Street"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?y
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?x "Mehmet"
